_comment: Differential-test manifest. Each case is a folder in tests/fixtures/ with a protein alignment and nuc.fasta. Every case runs with all 'variants'; 'extra_variants' add case-specific option sets. Expected outputs come from PAL2NAL v14 via scripts/make_golden.py.

clean.about: Matching IDs, one gap, synonymous differences (GTT/GTC, GCT/GCA)

clustal_input.about: Same as clean but protein alignment in CLUSTAL format

multiline_fasta.about: Wrapped sequences, header descriptions, spaces inside DNA

unordered_ids.about: Same IDs, DNA in a different order

codon_mismatch.about: s2 codon GAT (D) where alignment says V

inframe_stop.about: In-frame TAA shown as * in protein

terminal_stop.about: DNA has trailing stop codon absent from protein

utr.about: s1 has 5' UTR and 3' stop + polyA

frameshift.about: s2 has a '2' (one-base deletion) in the protein alignment

ambiguous_bases.about: NNN under X, and an IUPAC R in a codon
